name: Grid Flip Gallery
description: Masonry-style image grid with size buttons that change the column count, animating every tile to its new position with a GSAP Flip, random stagger and a blur flash.
contents: Grid of image tiles with mixed aspect ratios and small number labels
behavior: Clicking a size button re-flows the grid to a new column count with a staggered Flip animation
Container blurs and brightens briefly during the transition
Images dim by default and brighten on hover
On screens below 640px the column count is halved
editableByProps: Images, tile aspect ratios and labels
Size button labels and the column count for each
Colors, gap, max width, animation duration, stagger and ease, image brightness

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the blur and brightness flash during the transition
needsCodeEdit.where: keyframes array inside the fromTo call in handleSizeClick

fixed: Stagger order is random on every transition
Number of items drives the tile count, images repeat if fewer than items
